business_problem: AirAsia Next needed to accelerate software delivery and quality assurance for millions of regional customers without adding manual testing bottlenecks or slowing its engineering teams.
solution_summary: AirAsia Next extended its long-running Google Cloud estate with Google Antigravity and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to modernize software engineering and QA across the AirAsia group. The Google Antigravity agentic browser is used to simulate real user environments and run automated quality assurance testing, removing manual testing bottlenecks before releases. Google Antigravity agent manager and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform coordinate agentic workflows that automate complex coding tasks and generate production-ready code. The resulting changes move through serverless delivery pipelines on Cloud Run, with Cloud Logging providing operational visibility and BigQuery remaining part of the company's data architecture. This setup let AirAsia Next scale governed agentic development workflows while keeping software delivery fast and reliable.
